feedback: Revise. The candidate in front of me is the iteration 7 design (kp 2.5, sensor_size 0.016, base_speed 1.3, kd 0.3, ki 0.05, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2], line_loss search_left). Iteration 7 already raced it and scored 159.12, so racing it again adds no new information. Its rationale also says the next test is ki 0.05 to 0.1, but the controller field still reads ki 0.05. The rationale and the field do not match. Iteration 5 (search_right, otherwise identical) is the best raced design at 160.41. Iteration 7 showed the line-loss side changes almost nothing (s-bend line_loss_events 2.0 on both, slalom 1.0 on both, oval 1.25 vs 1.3). Every run since iteration 2 has ended off_track with max_error of about 0.060 to 0.063 m. Steering gain is exhausted, since kp 3.0 (iteration 4) overshot and kd 0.45 (iteration 6) pushed oval steering_oscillation to 0.333 and raised max_error. The untested lever is the integral term. Use the best design (line_loss search_right) and change only ki, from 0.05 to 0.1. Keep base_speed at 1.3, since oval finishes at 1.89 s show speed is adequate. Interpret the race as follows. If max_error falls on the oval and slalom, or line_loss_events fall on the s-bend, keep ki 0.1. If steering_oscillation rises above 0.3 on any track, or max_error rises above the iteration 5 values (0.0604, 0.0623, 0.0616 m), revert ki to 0.05 and stop tuning the controller gains.
requested_changes: Start from the iteration 5 design (best raced, 160.41): controller.line_loss search_right, kp 2.5, kd 0.3, base_speed 1.3, sensor_size 0.016, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2]. Change only controller.ki from 0.05 to 0.1, because iteration 7 showed line-loss direction changes little and the ki field in this candidate has not been moved.

If ki 0.1 raises max_error above the iteration 5 values (0.0604 oval, 0.0623 s-bend, 0.0616 slalom) or steering_oscillation above 0.3 on any track, revert controller.ki to 0.05 and make no further gain changes, since kp, kd and line_loss have each been tested.

If max_error and line_loss_events are both unchanged with ki 0.1, and completion_time is limiting on any track, test controller.base_speed 1.5 as the only next change, since iteration 5 shows speed is otherwise adequate.
